bug_description: Description does not persist. Use Quick edit on Build the pricing page. Replace its description with QA persistence check and save. Verify it in the card, then reload the page.
Due dates sort alphabetically. Reset. Open All tasks (tasks.html) and choose Due date ↑. Inspect the first page.
expected_behavior: Dates start Oct 21, Oct 22, Oct 23, Oct 23, Oct 27 in chronological order.

bug_description: Combining filters broadens the result. Reset. Select Ethan Zins as assignee and Done as status.
expected_behavior: Only Define project milestones and Set up the repository appear (2 tasks).

bug_description: Cancel commits a priority change. Reset. Use Quick edit on Map the onboarding journey. Change Priority from Medium to High. Click Cancel; reopen the task or inspect the card.
expected_behavior: Priority stays Medium because the edit was canceled.

bug_description: Edited due date moves back one day. Reset. Use Quick edit on Build the pricing page. Change Due date from 2026-10-30 to 2026-11-05 and save. Reopen the task.
Next page repeats the first page. Reset. Open All tasks (tasks.html). Note the first five task titles. Click Next.
expected_behavior: Page 2 shows tasks 6–10, starting with Test mobile navigation.

bug_description: Drag changes column but not task status. Reset. Drag Map the onboarding journey from To do into In progress. Open the moved card and inspect Status.
expected_behavior: The task’s status is In progress in the board, details, and List.

bug_description: Bulk archive affects unselected tasks. Reset. Check only Map the onboarding journey and click Archive selected. Open Archive.
expected_behavior: Only that one task is archived; 11 tasks remain active.

bug_description: Active-project summary includes archived tasks. Reset. Use Quick edit on Define project milestones and click Archive in its details. Inspect project summary and sidebar count.
expected_behavior: Active Total tasks is 11 and Completed is 3.

bug_description: Clear filters leaves assignee selected. Reset. Select Alex Morgan in All assignees. Click Clear filters.
expected_behavior: All 12 active tasks return and the assignee selector returns to All assignees.

bug_description: Escape does not close task details. Reset. Click Quick edit on any board task to open its dialog and press Escape.
expected_behavior: Escape dismisses the dialog without saving edits.

bug_description: Another tab keeps stale task data. Reset. Open the app in two tabs in the same browser context. In tab A use Quick edit to change Build the pricing page title to Pricing page ready and save. Return to tab B and inspect the card. Then reload tab B.
expected_behavior: The already-open second tab updates to the saved title without a manual reload.
